data.body: Gerrit PS5 LLM-Review +1 advisory dispositions: both FIXED. Present-but-non-object bindings/reverse fields now fail closed with RebarError(returncode=2); RED 2/2 before the fix, GREEN after. Absent fields still use legacy empty-index semantics, proven by an exact forward_missing_reverse contrast and a defect-seeded mutation. Updated rebar.bridge_fsck docstring to distinguish normal anomaly results from operational scan errors. Validation: 40 focused tests, 225 changed-surface tests, lint/complexity/raw-git, and mypy over 494 files all pass.
